thread:
deploy-bot: Starting sandbox deploy now. env=sandbox image=redwood/runtime:release-1.14.2-rc4 git=refs/tags/rel-1.14.2-rc4 sha=a1b2c3d4e5f6 initiated_by=@carla change_window=now->+30m strategy=canary(10%->50%->100%) obs=5m per-step. Steps: pull image, apply non-destructive migrations (none), restart api/workers, run smoke tests. Rollback target: rel-1.14.1 if errors or latency spike. ETA ~6m. :rocket:

carla: ack. kicking it off. will watch canary metrics, tagging release notes after final success.

sre_taylor: quick heads-up — we're scheduled for a separate load test in ~10m on staging. can we gate final ->100% until 15m if possible? want to avoid overlapping noisy infra. also set rollback threshold for p99 > 500ms or error-rate > 1%.

deploy-bot: Noted. Adjusting rollout to pause at 50% for 15m. thresholds applied: p99_ms=500 err_pct=1.0

mike_devops: please pin model-serving config to model:v2-quant to avoid autotag drift during canary. doing it now.

jin_qa: smoke started. hitting /health and /v1/generate on canary node. results so far:
```
/health -> 200 OK
/v1/generate -> 200, latency median 120ms, no errors in 30 reqs
logs: INFO model loaded: redwood-open-7b-quant
```

charlie_platform: watching infra dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood.internal/d/infra/sandbox-deploy quick glance: cpu/ram stable, no OOMs.

sre_taylor: noticed a small uptick in tail latency at +3m on canary(10%). p99 jumped to 420ms for a short burst, still under threshold. will continue to monitor.

carla: thanks — if stable at 50% for 15m we promote to 100%. leaving a note for release notes: "rc4: runtime improvements, batching kernel selection fix".

deploy-bot: Canary step -> 50% complete. pausing for 15m observation per gating. next step auto or manual: manual_ack required.

mike_devops: manual_ack from me once 15m pass unless we see regressions.

jin_qa: extended smoke at 50% (100 reqs). result summary: 98/100 success, 2 timeouts (all within 480-500ms). investigating one problematic payload; seems edge-case tokenization issue. filing ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/OPS-4321

carla: ok — two timeouts under threshold but open ticket. i'm comfortable moving to 100% if sre_taylor gives :thumbsup:.

sre_taylor: :thumbsup: moving to 100% now. keeping an eye on p99 for next 10m.

deploy-bot: Promotion started -> 100% rollout. finalizing.

deploy-bot: Deploy finished SUCCESS. env=sandbox image=redwood/runtime:release-1.14.2-rc4 git=rel-1.14.2-rc4 sha=a1b2c3d4e5f6 promoted to 100%. smoke summary: 198/200 success across canary+full. No rollback triggered. duration=~9m.

carla: tagging release notes and closing release checklist. thanks team :tada:

charlie_platform: will keep dashboard alerts pinned for 30m. postmortem/tickets if we see regression.

jin_qa: follow-up: OPS-4321 created for tokenization edge-case. not blocking.

mike_devops: pinned model-serving config confirmed. all good from infra side.

sre_taylor: monitoring continues for 30m. if anything crosses thresholds i'll notify and we can rollback to rel-1.14.1.

deploy-bot: Thread closed by deploy-bot. Logs: https://logs.redwood.internal/deploys/1715054321
